title: Online BBA Supply Chain Management | DSU Online
description: Pursue your Online BBA with an elective in Supply Chain Management at Dayananda Sagar University. Gain expertise in logistics, procurement & global operations.

blocks.x: Online BBA Program - Supply Chain Management
Logistics | Procurement | Operations | Forecasting | Global SCM

The BBA with Elective in Supply Chain Management (SCM) equips learners with strategic, analytical, and operational expertise to manage global supply networks, optimise logistics, streamline procurement, and enhance operations planning. Through industry-focused curriculum, demand forecasting, and real-world case studies, this program prepares professionals for high-growth careers across manufacturing, e-commerce, FMCG, logistics, retail, consulting, and global operations. Best for: Operations, logistics, e-commerce, manufacturing & SCM roles.
